rule: A quick filter count is the number of results that chip would show under the current search and advanced filters, ignoring the selected quick filter. Zero stays enabled, previous counts stay on screen while refetching, All has a count, rendering goes through ChipGroup count only. Summaries for sidebars and stat cards stay unfiltered.
adoptedAssumptions: New count endpoints are separate GET routes returning only counts, fetched by their own hook with placeholderData: keepPreviousData, mirroring the notes/tags/genres/quotes facets pattern. Counts are not embedded in paginated list responses, so fetching page 2 of an infinite list never recomputes them.
Every count query reuses the list's own WHERE builder with the quick filter axes cleared. No hand-copied WHERE.
Existing summary endpoints keep their shape and stay unfiltered.
/books, /my-library, the publisher books tab and /favorites share one endpoint: favorites is the library query with isFavorite forced true, and its chips are a subset of the library chip axes.
Mobile chip height: ChipGroup gets a 44px minimum touch target below sm on every page (decided 2026-09-24); the publishers-only override goes away.
